summary: Iteration 21 tested all four features. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (email-docs unauth 401, ops 403, invalid 400 with 'Enter a valid email address' message, admin 200 status:sent; regenerate-guides admin 200 ok; guide.pdf + guide.docx download 200 after regen). Frontend: Mobile card views verified at 390px for /app/team (member-cards-mobile, 2 cards + remove button), /app/vendors (vendor-cards-mobile, 4 cards), /app/agents (agent-cards-mobile, 3 cards) — desktop table hidden, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390). Desktop at 1920: full tables render with member-*/vendor-row-*/agent-row-* (2/4/3) and mobile card lists hidden. Risk Register /app/risks mobile still shows risk-cards-mobile and tap→lineage-modal (regression OK). Tablet two-pane at 1280: clicking left edge of Ref cell opens risk-detail-pane (contains inherent+residual pills, category, owner, exposure content), table stays visible, risk-detail-lineage opens lineage-modal, risk-detail-evidence present, risk-detail-close hides pane. Settings → Deployment & Documentation: email-docs-input + email-docs-send present; send disabled with empty input, enabled after valid email; clicking sent POST /api/deploy/email-docs → 200 and success toast 'Guide + package emailed to jblan2026@gmail.com'. No functional console errors (only 2 expected 401 /api/auth/me on pre-login page load).
critical_code_review_comments: Login form: pressing Enter submits reliably but clicking data-testid=auth-submit sometimes does not fire submit in Playwright (fields cleared without POST). Consider wiring button onClick explicitly to submit handler in addition to type=submit — reduces flakiness for automation.
Onboarding tour and Advisor panel both auto-open post-login on desktop; consider a single global 'first-visit' coordinator so tests and users don't dismiss two overlays back-to-back.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via Playwright: prefer pressing Enter in password field over clicking [data-testid=auth-submit] (the click sometimes fails to fire submit). Onboarding tour ('Skip') and Advisor ([data-testid=advisor-close]) both auto-open on first login — dismiss both. Risk Register table row CENTER is the $ Exposure button (opens EvidenceModal); click LEFT edge of first td cell to trigger risk-detail-pane. Email-docs endpoint payload uses field name 'to' (not 'email').
